text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":14,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"14 rock CDs"},{"id":"q2","value":12,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"12 classical CDs"},{"id":"q3","value":8,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"8 pop CDs"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"divide rock CDs (14) by classical CDs (12) to begin the Euclidean process for finding their greatest common factor"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q2"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply that quotient back by 12 to find the largest multiple of 12 not exceeding 14"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract to get the remainder -- the greatest common factor step between 14 and 12"},{"op":"div","args":["q3","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"check the pop CDs (8) against that remainder (2) to begin comparing it with the third quantity"},{"op":"mul","args":["s4","s3"],"out":"s5","note":"multiply that quotient back by the remainder to find the largest multiple not exceeding 8"},{"op":"sub","args":["q3","s5"],"out":"s6","note":"subtract to get the final remainder -- confirming the greatest common factor shared by all three CD counts"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"greatest number of CDs Oscar can pack in each box"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"states each box holds only one type of CD, not mixed types; this describes the packing rule, not a count used in the greatest-common-factor calculation"}]}
